spec.summary: Expose the profile command with input and output paths.

algorithm: Read the input CSV and treat its first row as the header.
Infer each column's type from its data without a schema.
Compute the specified profile and write it to --output.

input_schema.value: CSV whose first row is the header; subsequent rows are data.

spec.summary: Read a headered CSV without a schema and write its statistical profile as JSON.

algorithm: Ignore empty values for inference.
If all non-empty values parse with strconv.ParseInt base 10 bit size 64, infer int.
Otherwise, if all parse with strconv.ParseFloat bit size 64, infer float.
Otherwise, if all parse as RFC 3339 datetimes, infer datetime.
Otherwise infer string.
edge_cases: A column containing no non-empty values is string.
ordering: Test int before float, then datetime, then string; integer strings also parse as floats, so this order is significant.
spec.summary: Infer profile column types from non-empty values using ordered int, float, datetime, then string tests.

algorithm: For each header column, count non-empty, empty, and distinct non-empty raw values and emit its base fields.
invariants: Every column object always contains name, type, count, null_count, and unique.
ordering: columns follows header declaration order from left to right.

output_schema.value: Integer number of CSV data rows.
Array containing one object per header column.
Inferred type: int, float, string, or datetime.
Integer number of distinct non-empty values.

spec.summary: Emit top-level row count and one ordered base-statistics object per CSV column.

algorithm: Compute min and max over non-empty numeric values.
Compute arithmetic mean.
Compute population standard deviation.
Compute percentiles using the profile percentile algorithm.
edge_cases: For one numeric value, stddev is 0.

input_schema.value: All non-empty numeric values in an inferred int or float column.

output_schema.value: Minimum; JSON integer for int columns and JSON number for float columns.
Maximum with the same type formatting as min.

preconditions: Column type is int or float.
spec.summary: Compute required range, mean, population deviation, and percentile fields for int and float columns.

algorithm: Compute idx = p/100*(n-1).
If idx is integral, return values[idx].
Otherwise set lower=floor(idx), upper=ceil(idx), frac=idx-lower and interpolate between those positions.
ordering: Numeric values are sorted ascending before indexing.
spec.summary: Calculate numeric percentiles by linear interpolation over sorted values.

algorithm: Compute sample standard deviation s using denominator n-1.
If n<3 or s==0, emit null.
Otherwise compute the adjusted standardized third moment.
edge_cases: Return null when n<3 or s==0.
invariants: Sample s uses Bessel's correction, unlike population stddev.
spec.summary: Compute adjusted Fisher-Pearson skewness or null when undefined.

algorithm: If n<4 or s==0, emit null.
Otherwise compute the corrected fourth standardized moment minus its excess correction.
edge_cases: Return null when n<4 or s==0.
preconditions: Use the sample standard deviation s defined for skewness.
spec.summary: Compute sample excess kurtosis or null when undefined.

algorithm: Count occurrences of each numeric value.
Find the highest frequency.
Return null if count is zero or the highest frequency is one.
Otherwise choose the smallest value among those with highest frequency.
edge_cases: Null for no values or when every value occurs exactly once.
ordering: Mode ties are broken by numeric value ascending.

output_schema.value: JSON integer for int columns, JSON number for float columns, or null

spec.summary: Emit the repeated numeric mode with deterministic smallest-value tie breaking.

algorithm: If n is zero, return [].
If max==min, return one bin with low=max=min and count=n.
Otherwise compute width=(max-min)/10 and emit bins i=0..9 with low=min+i*width and high=min+(i+1)*width.
Assign v to floor((v-min)/width), clamped to 0..9.
edge_cases: Bins 0-8 are [low,high); bin 9 is [low,max].
Identical values produce a single {low:value,high:value,count:n} bin.
No values produce an empty array.

formatting.value: Same JSON number formatting as other profile statistics.

ordering: Bins are emitted in index order 0 through 9.
spec.summary: Emit a deterministic ten-bin equal-width histogram for numeric columns.

algorithm: Measure lengths in bytes.
Compute minimum, maximum, and arithmetic average length over non-empty values.
Count each non-empty value and retain the first five after required sorting.
edge_cases: Empty values do not participate.
ordering: most_common sorts count descending, then value ascending lexicographically; include all when fewer than five unique values exist.

output_schema.value: Integer minimum byte length, or 0 when count=0.
Integer maximum byte length, or 0 when count=0.
Number average byte length, or 0 when count=0.

spec.summary: Compute byte-length and frequency statistics for inferred string columns.

algorithm: Compare parsed instants chronologically and emit the minimum and maximum.

input_schema.value: Non-empty values parsed as RFC 3339 datetimes

output_schema.value: Earliest datetime formatted as RFC 3339 string.
Latest datetime formatted as RFC 3339 string.

spec.summary: Emit earliest and latest RFC 3339 values for datetime columns.

algorithm: For every numeric-column pair A,B with A before B, collect rows where both are non-empty.
If paired n<2, emit null.
Otherwise compute paired means, covariance numerator, and product-of-sums denominator.
If denominator is zero, emit null; otherwise emit numerator/denominator.
edge_cases: Fewer than two numeric columns produces [].
Paired n<2 or zero paired variance produces null.

input_schema.value: Columns inferred as int or float.
Rows where both columns have non-empty values.

invariants: Each unordered numeric-column pair appears exactly once with the earlier column as column_a.
ordering: Sort by column_a header position, then column_b header position.

output_schema.value: Pearson coefficient or null when undefined.

spec.summary: Compute ordered Pearson correlations for every header-ordered pair of numeric columns.

algorithm: Encode the complete profile as JSON.

formatting.value: JSON integers with no decimal point
Go default float64 JSON encoding with no unnecessary trailing zeros

spec.summary: Serialize profile output as canonical indented JSON.

algorithm: Construct a key combination from the selected columns for every row.
For keep=first, retain the first input-order row per key and discard later rows.
For keep=last, retain the last input-order row per key and discard earlier rows.

defaults.value: If omitted or empty, use all columns in header order.

ordering: Retained rows preserve their relative input order.

algorithm: Split each source cell using delimiter.
If the number of parts equals len(names), map them one-to-one.
If fewer, fill remaining named cells with empty strings.
If more, map initial parts normally and join all remaining parts with delimiter into the last named column.
edge_cases: Excess parts are rejoined only into the last named column.

errors.stderr: ERROR: invalid recipe: column <name> not found

input_schema.value: Ordered array of new column names

ordering: New columns follow names order and occupy the source column's original position; row order is unchanged.

output_schema.value: Original header with source removed and names inserted at its former position.

spec.summary: Replace one column in place with named delimiter-split columns.

algorithm: Evaluate expression for rows in current dataset order using the derive evaluator.
Continue while each result is >0.
On the first result <=0 or NaN, terminate immediately with its 1-indexed current-row position.
If all pass, return exactly the unchanged header and rows.
edge_cases: NaN is failure.

errors.condition: Row N is the first assertion failure.
errors.stderr: ERROR: assertion failed on row N: <message>

input_schema.value: Boolean expression using the same operators, functions, and column references as derive.

invariants: Successful assertion does not modify data.
ordering: Evaluate in current row order and report the first failing row.
spec.summary: Require a derive-language expression to be true for every current row.

algorithm: Collect every non-empty source value that parses as float64.
For zscore compute mean and population stddev; for minmax compute min and max.
For each row, emit empty string when source is empty or unparsable.
For zscore emit 0 when stddev==0, else (x-mean)/stddev.
For minmax emit 0 when max==min, else (x-min)/(max-min).
edge_cases: Empty or non-float cells produce empty output.
Zero stddev or zero range produces 0.

errors.stderr: ERROR: invalid recipe: column <name> not found

ordering: Preserve rows and original columns; append as last column.

output_schema.value: Last header column; contains normalized string or empty string.

spec.summary: Append z-score or min-max normalized numeric values.

algorithm: forward: scan each specified column top-to-bottom, replacing empties with the most recent non-empty value above; leave leading empties empty.
backward: scan each specified column bottom-to-top, replacing empties with the nearest non-empty value below; leave trailing empties empty.
constant: replace eligible empty values with value.

linear: for each empty cell at i, search upward for nearest non-empty float-parsable anchor (lo,v_lo) and downward for nearest non-empty float-parsable anchor (hi,v_hi); if both exist interpolate, otherwise leave empty.
Never modify a non-empty cell; for linear, skip non-empty unparsable cells as anchors but do not fill them.
edge_cases: Linear interpolation requires numeric anchors on both sides.
Non-empty unparsable cells are skipped in anchor searches and remain unchanged.

errors.condition: A referenced column does not exist.
errors.stderr: ERROR: invalid recipe: column <name> not found

input_schema.value: Columns whose empty values are eligible.
Replacement string required only for constant.

ordering: Preserve original row order and all columns; anchor searches use decreasing and increasing row index.
spec.summary: Fill empty cells using forward, backward, constant, or linear strategy without changing non-empty cells.

algorithm: Dispatch to onehot or ordinal semantics according to method.

errors.stderr: ERROR: invalid recipe: column <name> not found

Result-column name used only by ordinal.

spec.summary: Encode a categorical source column using one-hot or ordinal encoding.

algorithm: Collect unique non-empty source values and sort them lexicographically ascending.
Create one new column per value.
For each row and value emit 1 on equality and 0 otherwise; an empty source emits 0 in every new column.
If drop=true, remove source and insert new columns at its position; otherwise retain source and append new columns.
edge_cases: Empty values encode to all zeros.
ordering: New columns follow sorted category order.
drop=true preserves the source header index for the first new column; drop=false appends them at the end.
spec.summary: One-hot encode sorted unique non-empty values with configurable source-column retention.

algorithm: Collect unique non-empty source values and sort ascending lexicographically.
Assign strings 0, 1, ... in sorted order.
Emit the matching rank per non-empty row and empty string for an empty source.
Append the as column last.
edge_cases: Empty source values remain empty in the encoding.
ordering: Ranks follow ascending lexicographic category order; result column is last.

output_schema.value: Zero-based decimal rank string; empty string for empty source.

spec.summary: Ordinal-encode lexicographically sorted non-empty categories into zero-based rank strings.

algorithm: At detail level, group by all columns.
For k=len(columns)-1 down to 1, group by the first k columns and put * in grouping positions k through len(columns)-1.
At level 0, aggregate all rows and put * in every grouping column.
For every level apply aggregate semantics: numeric sum/avg/min/max skip empty and non-numeric values; count counts non-empty values; empty numeric sets yield sum=0 and avg/min/max=NaN.
edge_cases: Grand total is one row.

errors.condition: Any columns or aggregations[].column reference is absent.
errors.stderr: ERROR: invalid recipe: column <name> not found

input_schema.value: Grouping hierarchy from coarsest to finest.
Ordered {column,function,as} array; functions sum, avg, count, min, max.

spec.summary: Compute aggregate detail, hierarchy subtotals, and grand total using aggregate semantics.

algorithm: Emit one detail row per full grouping tuple.
Emit subtotal rows for every prefix length from len(columns)-1 through 1.
Emit one grand-total row.

output_schema.value: columns in declaration order followed by aggregation as names in declaration order.
Included prefix values followed by * markers.

spec.summary: Lay out rollup grouping and aggregation columns and level markers exactly.

algorithm: Emit all detail rows first, ascending lexicographically by all grouping columns left to right.
Then emit subtotal levels from finest to coarsest; within each level sort ascending by included grouping columns.
Emit grand total last.
ordering: detail; subtotal k=len(columns)-1 down to 1; grand total.
Within each applicable level compare grouping values left to right ascending lexicographically.
spec.summary: Order rollup rows by level and ascending grouping tuples.

formatting.value: No unnecessary trailing zeros or trailing decimal point.

spec.summary: Format rollup numeric aggregation results without redundant decimal characters.

algorithm: Collect all non-empty float-parsable source values and compute method thresholds.
For each row emit 0 if the cell is empty or unparsable; otherwise apply the selected method and emit 1 or 0.
edge_cases: Empty and non-numeric cells are never outliers.

errors.stderr: ERROR: invalid recipe: column <name> not found

ordering: Preserve row order and append as last column.

output_schema.value: Last column containing 1 for outlier or 0 otherwise.

spec.summary: Append a 1/0 outlier indicator computed from float-parsable source values.

algorithm: Compute Q1 and Q3 using the profile percentile interpolation algorithm.
Compute IQR=Q3-Q1.
Mark v as outlier exactly when below the lower fence or above the upper fence.
edge_cases: With fewer than two numeric values, emit 0 for every row.

formulas.value: v < Q1 - factor*IQR or v > Q3 + factor*IQR

invariants: Fence equality is not an outlier.
spec.summary: Detect outliers beyond factor-scaled interquartile fences.

algorithm: Compute population mean and population standard deviation over collected values.
Mark v as outlier when its absolute z-score is strictly greater than factor.
edge_cases: If stddev==0, emit 0 for every value.
invariants: Equality to factor is not an outlier.
spec.summary: Detect outliers by absolute population z-score.

algorithm: Compute median of all collected numeric values.
Compute absolute deviations abs(xi-median) and their median MAD.
When MAD is nonzero, mark v when abs(modified_z)>factor.
When MAD is zero, mark values unequal to median and do not mark values equal to median.
edge_cases: MAD==0: v==median emits 0; v!=median emits 1.

integration.value: Use profile percentile interpolation at p=50.

spec.summary: Detect outliers by modified median absolute-deviation score.

algorithm: Collect all non-empty values that parse as floats.
For each row emit empty string when the source is empty or unparsable; otherwise assign using the selected method.
edge_cases: Non-float cells produce empty labels.

errors.stderr: ERROR: invalid recipe: column <name> not found

ordering: Preserve rows and append as last column.

output_schema.value: Last column containing a bin label or empty string.

spec.summary: Append width- or quantile-bin labels for float-parsable source values.

algorithm: If max==min, label every numeric value [val,val].
Otherwise compute w=(max-min)/bins and i=floor((v-min)/w), clamped to 0..bins-1.
Compute low=min+i*w and high=min+(i+1)*w, except final high=max.
Use a right-exclusive label except for the final bin.
edge_cases: Constant data uses [val,val].
spec.summary: Assign values to equal-width bins with exact interval labels.

algorithm: If max==min, label every numeric value [val,val].
Compute boundary j for j=0..bins as the percentile at j*100/bins using profile interpolation.
Choose the highest i in 0..bins-1 for which v>=boundary[i].
Use boundary[i] and boundary[i+1] as bounds, except force final high=max.
Use a right-exclusive label except for the final bin.
edge_cases: Constant data uses [val,val].
Repeated percentile boundaries are permitted; highest qualifying i wins.
spec.summary: Assign values to equal-frequency percentile-boundary bins.

ordering: Duplicate resolution uses input file order.

Validate every key column.
